name: OIML R-76-1:2006 Metrological Requirements
description: Standardized Maximum Permissible Error (MPE) thresholds, eccentricity tolerances, and repeatability limits per OIML R-76-1:2006.

rules.name: Maximum Permissible Error for Indication (Linearity)
rules.description: Evaluates whether indication error at each applied reference test load does not exceed the applicable MPE in units of verification scale intervals e. The last bracket of each class is open-ended (max_e: null) to handle any load within the instrument's rated capacity. Per the standard, instruments must not be loaded beyond their rated maximum capacity, so the bracket is effectively bounded by Max/e = n_max.

rules.name: Eccentricity Indication Error Limit
rules.description: The errors of indication at each eccentric position shall not exceed the maximum permissible error for the applied test load.

rules.name: Repeatability Span Limit (Max - Min)
rules.description: The difference between maximum and minimum results obtained in repeated weighings of the same load shall not exceed the absolute value of the MPE for that load.

rules.name: Experimental High-Precision Sensor Drift Threshold
rules.source_reference: Draft Proposal SIH26035 Working Group Note 4
rules.description: Hypothetical additional restriction on standard deviation to mean ratio under thermal drift conditions. Marked strictly as pending verification until metrological authority approves.
